answer_4.quote: We conducted a user study to see the effect of learning on example sentences selected by EMLA, CMLA, and a random baseline. In this learner study, a total of 29 Chinese‑speaking college freshmen majored in English were recruited.
answer_4.guideline: Participants completed a pre‑test and a post‑test consisting of fill‑in‑the‑blank multiple‑choice questions. Example sentences generated by each model were shown during the post‑test. Improvement was measured by comparing pre‑test and post‑test scores, and a questionnaire collected ratings of difficulty and usage of example sentences.
